properties.name: A deliverable declares who it is for — `Artifact.audience`, and a need nothing consumer-facing delivers is reported
properties.rationale: Anthony's ruling: merge the duplicate rules, and build the proxy detector advisory rather than blocking. The requirement exists because a rule binds only the people building reflow2 while a requirement makes it something reflow2 DOES for every project — the split `req:a-fix-says-whether-it-corrected-the-cause` established at his request on 2026-08-17. NEVER PATH-DERIVED: a first sketch classified by directory, which encodes one project's layout and is the exact failure the rule forbids. MUTATION-CHECKED THREE WAYS; the third mutation caught nothing, which proved a guard dead and exposed that `vocabulary_coverage` names unused node and edge TYPES but never PROPERTIES — recorded as an open hole rather than closed.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: `Artifact.audience` (`consumer` | `internal`) added to the schema, reachable through `set_artifact_intent` beside granularity and volatility, refused outside the enum. New `internal_only_delivery` finding names a Requirement whose every DECLARED delivering artifact is internal with none declared consumer — per-requirement, severity 0.45. Also merges the two duplicate DesignRules stating that reflow2 is built for other projects, moving all six governance edges to the survivor, and adds `req:work-says-whether-it-reaches-a-consumer` as the product form of that rule.
